statement: Define Cover(S), for S a subset of {0,...,n-1}, to mean: for every real x with 0 <= x <= time there exists i in S with clips[i][0] <= x <= clips[i][1]. Whenever video_stitching clips time returns a result r: if no subset S of {0,...,n-1} satisfies Cover(S), then r = -1; otherwise r is the least nonnegative integer k such that some subset S with |S| = k satisfies Cover(S).
preconditions: Let n = len(clips). Assume 1 <= n <= 100; for each i with 0 <= i < n, clips[i] has length 2, write clips[i] = [s_i, e_i], and 0 <= s_i <= e_i <= 100; and 1 <= time <= 100.

statement: video_stitching clips time returns a result r; it does not fail (no panic, out-of-bounds access, or i64 overflow) on any input satisfying the preconditions.
preconditions: Let n = len(clips). Assume 1 <= n <= 100; for each i with 0 <= i < n, clips[i] has length 2, write clips[i] = [s_i, e_i], and 0 <= s_i <= e_i <= 100; and 1 <= time <= 100.

statement: Define U = {x : 0 <= x <= time and there exists i with clips[i][0] <= x <= clips[i][1]}. Whenever video_stitching clips time returns r, r = -1 iff U is not equal to the whole interval [0,time] (equivalently, the union of all clip intervals does not cover [0,time]).
preconditions: Let n = len(clips). Assume 1 <= n <= 100; for each i with 0 <= i < n, clips[i] has length 2, write clips[i] = [s_i, e_i], and 0 <= s_i <= e_i <= 100; and 1 <= time <= 100.

statement: Whenever video_stitching clips time returns r and r != -1, there exists a subset S of {0,...,n-1} such that |S| = r and for every real x with 0 <= x <= time there is i in S with clips[i][0] <= x <= clips[i][1].
preconditions: Let n = len(clips). Assume 1 <= n <= 100; for each i with 0 <= i < n, clips[i] has length 2, write clips[i] = [s_i, e_i], and 0 <= s_i <= e_i <= 100; and 1 <= time <= 100.

statement: Whenever video_stitching clips time returns r and r != -1, for every subset S of {0,...,n-1} with |S| < r, it is not true that for every real x with 0 <= x <= time there is i in S with clips[i][0] <= x <= clips[i][1].
preconditions: Let n = len(clips). Assume 1 <= n <= 100; for each i with 0 <= i < n, clips[i] has length 2, write clips[i] = [s_i, e_i], and 0 <= s_i <= e_i <= 100; and 1 <= time <= 100.

statement: Whenever video_stitching clips time returns r, either r = -1 or 1 <= r <= n.
preconditions: Let n = len(clips). Assume 1 <= n <= 100; for each i with 0 <= i < n, clips[i] has length 2, write clips[i] = [s_i, e_i], and 0 <= s_i <= e_i <= 100; and 1 <= time <= 100.

statement: If there exists an index i with 0 <= i < n, clips[i][0] <= 0, and clips[i][1] >= time, then whenever video_stitching clips time returns r, r = 1.
preconditions: Let n = len(clips). Assume 1 <= n <= 100; for each i with 0 <= i < n, clips[i] has length 2, write clips[i] = [s_i, e_i], and 0 <= s_i <= e_i <= 100; and 1 <= time <= 100.

statement: Whenever video_stitching clips time returns r and r = 1, there exists an index i with 0 <= i < n, clips[i][0] <= 0, and clips[i][1] >= time.
preconditions: Let n = len(clips). Assume 1 <= n <= 100; for each i with 0 <= i < n, clips[i] has length 2, write clips[i] = [s_i, e_i], and 0 <= s_i <= e_i <= 100; and 1 <= time <= 100.

statement: If there is no index i with 0 <= i < n and clips[i][0] <= 0, then whenever video_stitching clips time returns r, r = -1.
preconditions: Let n = len(clips). Assume 1 <= n <= 100; for each i with 0 <= i < n, clips[i] has length 2, write clips[i] = [s_i, e_i], and 0 <= s_i <= e_i <= 100; and 1 <= time <= 100.

statement: If there is no index i with 0 <= i < n and clips[i][1] >= time, then whenever video_stitching clips time returns r, r = -1.
preconditions: Let n = len(clips). Assume 1 <= n <= 100; for each i with 0 <= i < n, clips[i] has length 2, write clips[i] = [s_i, e_i], and 0 <= s_i <= e_i <= 100; and 1 <= time <= 100.

statement: Whenever video_stitching clips time returns r and video_stitching clips' time returns r', we have r' = r.
preconditions: Let n = len(clips). Assume 1 <= n <= 100; for each i with 0 <= i < n, clips[i] has length 2, write clips[i] = [s_i, e_i], and 0 <= s_i <= e_i <= 100; and 1 <= time <= 100. Let clips' be any slice of Vec I64 obtained by permuting clips; assume len(clips') = n and clips' also satisfies the endpoint constraints 0 <= start <= end <= 100 for every entry.

statement: Whenever video_stitching clips time returns r with r != -1 and video_stitching clips' time returns r', we have r' != -1 and r' <= r.
preconditions: Let n = len(clips). Assume 1 <= n <= 100; for each i with 0 <= i < n, clips[i] has length 2, write clips[i] = [s_i, e_i], and 0 <= s_i <= e_i <= 100; and 1 <= time <= 100. Let clips' be obtained from clips by inserting one or more additional two-element intervals, each satisfying 0 <= start <= end <= 100, so 1 <= len(clips') <= 100.

statement: If there exist indices i and j with 0 <= i,j < n such that clips[i][0] <= 0, clips[j][1] >= time, and clips[j][0] <= clips[i][1], then whenever video_stitching clips time returns r, r = 2.
preconditions: Let n = len(clips). Assume 1 <= n <= 100; for each i with 0 <= i < n, clips[i] has length 2, write clips[i] = [s_i, e_i], and 0 <= s_i <= e_i <= 100; and 1 <= time <= 100. Also assume no index i satisfies clips[i][0] <= 0 and clips[i][1] >= time (so no single clip covers [0,time]).

statement: Whenever video_stitching clips time returns r and r = k >= 1, there exist distinct indices i_0, ..., i_{k-1} in {0,...,n-1} such that: (a) clips[i_0][0] <= 0; (b) max over 0 <= h < k of clips[i_h][1] is at least time; (c) for every j with 1 <= j < k, clips[i_j][0] <= max over 0 <= h < j of clips[i_h][1].
preconditions: Let n = len(clips). Assume 1 <= n <= 100; for each i with 0 <= i < n, clips[i] has length 2, write clips[i] = [s_i, e_i], and 0 <= s_i <= e_i <= 100; and 1 <= time <= 100.
